name: Crescent Eve
summary: An Eid greeting on a lantern-lit rooftop night, with a gift envelope and nine glass lanterns to ring
about: A full-page Eid greeting set over old city rooftops: the crescent moon rises, strings of glass lanterns drop in and swing, and the greeting writes itself in shimmering gold. A green envelope breaks its seal and slides out a gift note, and ringing all nine lanterns fills the sky with fireworks. Type the names, message and gift, then copy the link so whoever opens it sees their own greeting.
how: Open the page: the moon rises, the rooftops slide up and the lantern strings drop in and swing.
Move your pointer past the lanterns to sway them, or tap one to make it ring with sparks.
Press Open your Eid gift: the seal breaks, the flap lifts and the gift note slides out.
Ring all nine lanterns to set off fireworks over the rooftops.
In Make it yours, type the names, message and gift, then press Copy link and send it.
